from sklearn.metrics.classification import confusion_matrix
from itertools import product
import cv2

input_path = "path/to/image.png"

def calculate_I_in_strings(input_path, labels=['baseball', 'basket']):
    confusion_matrix = confusion_matrix(*labels)
    score = 0
    for i in product(*confusion_matrix):
        if str(i[0]) in 'ij':
            score += i[1]
    return score / len(labels)

final_result = calculate_I_in_strings(input_path)
</command>
